name: India Is Building AI That Understands Its Languages

fields.YouTube title: India Is Building AI That Understands Its Languages
fields.YouTube description (includes hashtags):
Chariot Artificial Intelligence has unveiled Chariot-1, a family of language and speech models trained from scratch in India.

Its largest language model has 10.7 billion parameters, with around 4 billion active per token. The company’s IndicShift technique aims to make Indian-language text processing more efficient, with a reported reduction in token counts of up to 60% in its launch evaluation. The official launch announcement reports coverage of 12 Indian scripts; the released tokenizer documentation names ten scripts that share letter symbols. Nested Training develops three model sizes through a single training run.

Supported by the IndiaAI Mission, the suite also includes multilingual speech technology supporting English and at least ten Indian languages. The reported token reduction is a best-case evaluation result, not a universal improvement or an independent benchmark.
